claims.assertion: Urmah are the dominant feline species, originating in Vega, Lyra and Avalon, with colonies across thousands of planets, especially Sirius.
claims.speaker: Swaruu

claims.assertion: Swaruu says Urmah and Lyrians share origins and once cooperated; Urmah are now peaceful, militarized Federation members.
claims.speaker: Swaruu

claims.assertion: They are bipedal feline carnivores but make synthetic meat; telepathy predominates though they can speak.
claims.speaker: Swaruu

claims.assertion: Urmah society uses balanced patriarchal-matriarchal councils and U-shaped, warp-capable starships.
claims.speaker: Swaruu

claims.assertion: Anéeka says Taygetans introduced domestic cats in ancient Egypt, possibly alongside others; Urmah only interacted with Earth, without major colonies.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
